whoItsFor: Engineers, makers, and designers who want an open-source parametric 3D CAD tool for sketching, constraining, and building solids, plus AI agents that need to model and measure parts through the MCP server.
useCases: Model parametric parts with constrained sketches, features, and a rebuilding timeline
Export designs to STEP, IGES, STL, 3MF, or OBJ for manufacturing and 3D printing
Let AI agents model, measure, and render parts headlessly with solidcraft-cli mcp

requirements.os: Windows, macOS, or Linux (or a web browser)
